scope: Optional ReadOccurrencePage preparation on the declared Linux arm64 Node v24.20.0 profiles. Legacy full Trace and whole-host combined capacity are not qualified.
implementation: One ordered resumable validation phase description, per-record exact-source query and operation indexes, prefix validation, cooperative projection, item mapping and complete history schema validation. Shared position predicate; private accumulators publish only after complete success.
measurement: Every scheduled read-fiber task including initial native read is measured by synchronous wall span and main-thread threadCpuUsage. Named phases include prefix selection/envelope, cancellation multiplicity, query indexing, operation indexing, projection final Schema and individual item schema. Heartbeat gaps and total asynchronous preparation are not chunk clocks. Memory includes test-host overhead and excludes children. Provider settlement is reported separately from receipt-to-executeAttachedCommand admission.
profileSelection: Each of three executable test cases runs in a separate process to avoid accumulation of retained diagnostic raw spans across cases; each case still has 20 cold reopens and 20 warm samples in one Node process. Cold means host/SQLite scopes, not cold Node binary. Dense remains four tasks/seven graph edges/six causal edges/four obligations/512 initial Pause directions/no watches. Oversized adds an unchanged 8192 UTF8-byte required TaskId. Uncached adds a read-only scan before measurement to invalidate store read snapshots.
reproduction: For each profile Dense, DenseOversized8192Utf8Bytes, DenseOversizedUncachedSqlite separately: DALPH_PROFILE_CANDIDATE=$(git rev-parse HEAD) NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1024 timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15s 120s mise exec -- pnpm exec vitest run --config .scratch/combined-profile.config.mjs -t "^<profile> native cold host reopen and warm public admission profile$"; preserve output before next case; record UTC stop two minutes after start.
